originalText:
This is the part people don’t show enough about AI game dev on X.

Behind every “Fable 5 made me a full game in one prompt” post, there’s usually a lot of bullshit.

I gave AI a strong /goal:
optimized Three.js grass, chunks, LOD, shader wind.
It produced something.
It understood part of the direction.

But it still missed.
That’s the real workflow.

A prompt can give you a starting point.
It doesn’t magically give you taste, debugging, optimization, and iteration.

You can test the /goal below.

everything rebuilt and animated, the kind of thing a studio ships, not a dev placeholder:

what used to take a small team months and a real budget now takes one prompt and an afternoon

and the same engine turns a novel's world into a walkable place you can actually sell
